title.zh: 表示数字的最少运算符

desc.zh: 从 3×3−3÷3 推导保留两种进位选择的数位动态规划。
desc.en: Derive a two-state digit DP from 3×3−3÷3 and compare direct and complement costs.

complexity: O(1 + log_x(target)) time; O(1) auxiliary space

concepts.name: Signed power costs
concepts.description: Count powers with a joining sign and compare complements.

concepts.name: Two-state digit DP
concepts.description: Keep the processed residue and its complement.
